quality_rule.scope: SP row quality only; raw retention, no aggregation or deduplication

observations.spatial_scope: AOI first; H3 r6 requires a separate spatial output
observations.primary: sum of quality-passed, deduplicated detection FRP within each platform/day/turn
observations.no_positive_records: null; no observed zero or complete coverage inferred
observations.daily_observed_partial_turns: sum available positive observations, explicitly incomplete; not a full calibrated daily estimate

deduplication.conflicting_value_resolution: SP, descending Float64 FRP, descending confidence, ascending detection_id, source SHA-256, original data-row index
deduplication.coordinate_rounding_tie_rule: CPython Float64 round(value, 5); engine behavior pinned by tests, not claimed identical to Decimal/numpy/DuckDB
deduplication.successive_pass_variant: A declared baseline, preserve direct sums after exact deduplication

calibration.combination: convex inverse-training-MAE weights; never add Terra and Aqua estimates
calibration.missing_turn_estimate_policy: require D and N per platform; use only a complete platform, otherwise null

sample_floor.fallback: same platform/turn across seasons, retaining both training floors

validation.approval_status: not_run; thresholds and adequate independent data still required
validation.weekly_scale_resolution: Publish paired daily mean and seven-day equivalent separately; delivery 4 must identify metric/MAE units

limitations: Current real dataset is fifteen dry-season days in 2020, not a calibration or validation sample covering the declared periods.
Numerical example coefficients and weights are illustrative and must not enter production parameters.
Observational quality criteria do not approve harmonization or prove clear-sky coverage.
Current experimental snapshot and original map are unchanged.
Companion recommends paired daily means while the revised main document specifies seven-day equivalents; no MAE scale selected implicitly.
